quizName:
Hardest Questions in Tennessee
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign tells drivers that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: If you get tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you get tired while driving, stop to rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness makes it hard to think clearly and slows your reactions. This makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, you should:

options.text: Drive faster to get to your destination sooner.
Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.
questions.explanation: Watch for signs of tiredness while driving. You are too tired if your eyes are closing, you drift out of your lane, or you turn up the radio and open windows to stay awake. If you notice these signs, park safely and take a short nap.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before going.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before going.
questions.explanation: You must stop at railroad crossings with warning signs, lights, or flaggers. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction shown by the arrow. In this case, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: In a car with airbags, where should children age 12 and under sit?

options.text: The bed of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags help protect adults but can hurt children. All children age 12 and under should sit in the back seat of a car with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign says you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around at this intersection.

questions.question: When driving in work zones, you should:

options.text: Follow the car ahead very closely.
Pass the car ahead as soon as you can.
Keep a safe distance and do not tailgate.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep a safe distance and do not tailgate.
questions.explanation: In work zones, stay far from barriers, trucks, equipment, workers, and other vehicles. Do not tailgate. Keep more distance between your car and others.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers to watch for bicycles, animals, and people that may cross traffic.

questions.question: If you need to stop suddenly on an interstate, you should:

options.text: Honk your horn to get other drivers' attention.
Get out and flag down the next car that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your car if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on emergency flashers, and stay in your car if possible.
questions.explanation: If you stop on the shoulder of an interstate, turn on your emergency flashers. Stay inside your car if you can. Traffic moves very fast on interstates, so walking or standing on the shoulder is very dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs only warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells drivers that roadwork is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:

options.text: Help you be a better driver.

questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Sleepiness slows reaction time, decreases awareness, and affects judgment—just like drugs and alcohol.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs hurt many driving skills, including reaction time, coordination, alertness, and ability to concentrate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: If you have an argument and feel angry, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about the argument.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the interstate to feel better.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Your emotions affect your ability to drive safely. If you are angry, excited, afraid, worried, or sad, calm down before driving. You need to focus your mind on driving, not on upsetting thoughts.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted where drivers are not allowed to enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter a one-way street or expressway ramp in the wrong direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, what should you do?
questions.explanation: The safest choice is to get out of the aggressive driver's way. Do not compete with other drivers. Always follow traffic rules to prevent crashes.

questions.question: If you become drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop at the first rest stop or service area. You can nap, stretch, or let another driver take over. Caffeine pills are not safe—they are not a real replacement for rest and can make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: A truck or bus is making a right turn where you also need to turn right. What should you do?

options.text: Quickly turn before the truck or bus.
Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn.
questions.explanation: Never squeeze between a turning truck or bus and the curb. You could be hit. Always wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.

questions.question: The traffic light is green, but a police officer signals you to stop. What should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: Always obey a police officer's signals, even if they go against traffic signals, signs, or road markings.

questions.question: At a crosswalk, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks. You must stop for them, whether the crosswalk is marked or not. Pedestrians must obey traffic control signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Wet pavement causes you to lose control. Slow down when you see this sign because it takes longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: You want to turn right. A pedestrian with a guide dog is at the corner ready to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross.

questions.explanation: People using guide dogs or white canes (with or without a red tip) always have the right-of-way. Wait for them to cross before you turn.

questions.question: When can a driver license be revoked or suspended?

options.text: Getting 12 or more points on your driving record in one year.

questions.explanation: A license can be revoked or suspended for fraudulently altering a license or getting 12 or more points in 12 months. Drivers under 18 may have their license suspended for 6 or more points in 12 months.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: If you are getting tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: Take breaks every hour on long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so you can sleep while they drive.
